name: Dreaming with Elsa
source:
It’s a game about Jason, who has been dreaming about a girl. One day, his work, as a clerk, leads him into a bookstore and he sees the girl he has been dreaming about. From then on we follow Jason on a journey to get to know Elsa and their shared dreams.

[From [url=http://www.mortzeart.com/?page_id=17]Official site[/url]]
translation:
这是一款关于杰森的游戏。他一直梦见一个女孩。某天，他作为店员工作时来到一家书店，看见了梦中的女孩。从那以后，我们将跟随杰森踏上了解艾尔莎以及他们共同梦境的旅程。

[来源：[url=http://www.mortzeart.com/?page_id=17]官方网站[/url]]
